title: User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for databraryr
text:
0.1 About
This repository documents the procedures used to test the databraryr R package.

title: User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for databraryr
text:
0.2 Set-up
Install the package from GitHub.
devtools::install_github(repo = "NYU-Databrary/databraryr", ref = "uat-rog")






Important



Note that I am testing from the uat-rog branch.

title: 2  Institutions
text:
2.1 About
This page documents testing of functions related to institutions.

title: 2  Institutions
text:

library(databraryr)

Welcome to the databraryr package.

         client_id = Sys.getenv("DB_API_CLIENT_ID"),
         client_secret = Sys.getenv("DB_API_CLIENT_SECRET"),
